source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
A datasheet groups faction keywords apart from its other keywords. Their rules work alike, except that faction keywords govern which models can go into an army. The full keyword is the bold uppercase entry.

Check whether a rule names a unit or a model. A unit check uses the keywords present in its models, so one qualifying model is enough. A model check uses that model’s own tags. A mixed unit can therefore match a unit-level condition even though only some of its members match the same model-level condition. Apply the same distinction to rules that exclude a keyword. For attacks, check the target unit as a whole when the rule names the unit. If it names a model, apply the effect only to the qualifying target model.

Commas, an explicit “or”, or slashes can mark alternative keywords. Satisfying a single alternative is enough. Adjacent keywords without separators must be satisfied together by the unit or model under test. For older wording that gives keywords without a subject, check the unit. Singular and plural forms of a keyword work alike.
